risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (413.44) with flat yield curve, imminent FOMC event in 2 days, and negative macro score (-5) create severely adverse conditions; earnings in 52 days adds secondary risk layer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9-period), 15x volume spike, and supertrend bullish signal with contrarian fear-zone sentiment create technical bounce potential near support at 20.8759.
debate.key_bear_argument: Pervasive bearish structure (price below all MAs, three black crows, negative CMF/MACD, no bullish confirmation), zero fundamental conviction, crisis-level VIX (413.44), imminent FOMC in 2 days, and 52-day earnings risk make this a high-probability continued downtrend trap.
